messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH severity — unusual auth traffic from multiple regions to /api/v1/ingest. 2000 req/min, some 403->200 transitions. Auto-attach: logs, top IPs. @sre-oncall please ack :rotating_light:

alice: acked. digging into logs now. seeing repeated token header `x-service-token` from same service account across regions.

sre-oncall: I'm slicing by svcacct. top actor svc:prod-indexer-2. Seems to be used from two ephemeral IP ranges 34.201.0.0/16 & 18.132.0.0/16. Blocking those ranges at the edge for now.

alice: pushing WAF block, will add rate-limit rule. also seeing S3 access logs in staging that include AUTH header samples — possible log leak. grabbing sample keys (redacted) and count.

bob-eng: confirming: those S3 objects are from a debug job that writes logs with headers. I’ll yank the log-drain and rotate the job creds.

carol-cs: any customer impact yet? should I prep comms?

dave-sec: tagging. If logs contain auth headers we must treat as potential secret exposure. Steps: 1) rotate implicated service account keys immediately 2) invalidate sessions/tokens that used those keys 3) start targeted customer impact assessment 4) preserve evidence for forensics.

sre-oncall: initiating key rotation for svc:prod-indexer-2 — calling KMS rotate and creating new IAM key. Command run: ```aws iam create-access-key --user-name svc-prod-indexer-2``` posted new key id for rotation job. Old key set to disabled state (not deleted) to avoid side effects.

alice: running search across logging bucket for any other objects containing `x-service-token` header snippets. query: ```gsutil cat gs://staging-logs/* | rg "x-service-token" -n | wc -l``` result ~12 hits in the last 48h. Flagging objects for secure erase.

bob-eng: I’ve updated the debug job to redact headers, removed log-drain config, and replaced credentials. Will push a canary to confirm no more header writes. ETA 6m.

sre-oncall: Edge blocks in place, WAF rule active, rate-limit applied. Traffic volume down to baseline 80% reduction.

carol-cs: I'll draft an internal customer note: "We detected elevated auth traffic related to a service account; we have rotated keys and mitigated exposure. No evidence of customer data exfiltration. We will follow up with details." Want to share with legal before sending.

legal: please include: which customers (if any) accessed by the implicated tokens, timeframe, and confirmation of rotation + logs scrubbed. don't mention specifics of forensics. We might need to notify if headers contained customer identifiers.

alice: quick forensic notes: timestamps 2026-03-15T02:12Z -> 2026-03-16T05:47Z show repeated requests with token header. Request sample (redacted): ```POST /api/v1/ingest 200 OK
Headers: x-service-token: REDACTED-...
Body: {"event": "index"}``` no customer payloads in these samples, mostly telemetry.

dave-sec: good. proceed with key rotation confirmation and revoke any active sessions created since 2026-03-15T00:00Z. Also create allowlist for internal services so rotation doesn't break flows.

bob-eng: revoked old key, rotated config in staging and prod; ran smoke tests: ingestion ok, no auth errors.

carol-cs: I'm coordinating a short customer advisory and will wait for legal signoff. Targeting a brief to customers within affected timeframe; classification: P2 (potential secret exposure, no confirmed customer data).

sre-oncall: follow-up ops tasks: - schedule job to securely delete the 12 flagged log objects - enable automatic header redaction on debug pipelines - add a lint check to block writes of full headers to S3 - postmortem scheduled tomorrow 10:00 PT.

dave-sec: I opened a ticket for compliance + retention to preserve copies for 90 days in the secure forensics bucket. DO NOT DELETE until legal OK.

alice: scrub task queued: `rm` replaced with secure-wipe script, objects moved to secure-forsensics bucket first.

legal: reviewed draft. ok to send customer advisory after we confirm no customer payloads and rotation completed. keep wording high-level.

carol-cs: confirmed rotation complete and no customer payloads found in the samples. Sending advisory now. Will post copy here once sent.

sre-oncall: all mitigation steps done. creating a follow-up incident summary for the postmortem with timelines and mitigations.

dave-sec: thanks team. next: root-cause analysis — why debug job wrote headers and how to prevent regen. assign to bob-eng + alice.

bob-eng: taking RCA. will look into pipeline config and add a PR with the lint/redaction change today.

incident-bot: Incident marked RESOLVED (mitigations applied). Playbook: sec/rotate-keys, ops/remove-leaked-logs, cs/notify-cust, legal/archive-evidence. Postmortem scheduled. :white_check_mark:
